# Golf Caddie - Simple Scorecard

> Golf Caddie is a minimalist golf scorecard app for iPhone and Apple Watch. It has no account, no GPS, and no subscription. You score each hole with a tap, with Siri, or from the Lock Screen. The core app is free with unlimited rounds; Golf Caddie Pro is a one-time $2.99 purchase.

Golf Caddie is made by an independent developer, Carlos Lopez-Molina. It is built for casual golfers who want fast, simple scoring without GPS rangefinders, swing analysis, or social feeds. It is a lightweight alternative to full-featured golf apps such as Arccos, Golfshot, and 18Birdies.

## Key facts

- Platforms: iPhone (iOS 17.6 or later) and Apple Watch
- App Store ID: 6760603837
- Category: Sports
- Price: Free download with unlimited rounds, stats, scorecard sharing, CSV export, and club distances (iPhone and Apple Watch)
- Golf Caddie Pro: one-time $2.99 in-app purchase, no subscription. Unlocks Apple Watch scoring, Siri voice scoring, and the Lock Screen Live Activity
- Free trial: 14 days of Pro, no credit card required
- No account or sign-up. No GPS and no course database, so it works on any course, even without signal
- Data: rounds are stored in the user's own iCloud account. The developer collects no personal data, analytics, or crash reports

## What it does

- Tracks strokes, putts, and penalties per hole, with score vs par (eagle, birdie, par, bogey)
- Quick Start rounds: Front 9, Back 9, or 18 holes in seconds; custom par for any hole
- Share a traditional scorecard image with golf marks (free)
- Club distances cheat sheet on iPhone and Apple Watch (free)
- Scoring averages and trends across rounds (free)
- Apple Health: log rounds as a Golf workout, with optional live heart rate and calories on Apple Watch
- Export every round as a CSV spreadsheet (free)
- Siri commands include "Add a stroke in Golf Caddie", "Next hole in Golf Caddie", and "What's my round score in Golf Caddie?" (Pro)
